scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && npm run prepare:resources -w desktop && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run package -w desktop
scripts.desktop:make: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run make -w desktop
